verdict.rationale: Persona's Workflows provide no-code conditional logic, risk-based routing, and automated decisioning (tag high-risk, run reports on conditions), while Inquiry Templates/Dynamic Flow Templates house configuration for verifications, screens, decisioning, and theming without engineering deploys. Country-specific requirements aren't explicitly documented but templates and dynamic flows imply configurable, condition-based data collection. Missing for 10: explicit mention of country-specific rule configuration, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
